bio.text: Angie Guerrero-Cuellar is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 22nd District, serving since February 2021, according to the Illinois General Assembly, where Guerrero-Cuellar is listed as Angelica Guerrero-Cuellar.

Guerrero-Cuellar's legislature biography says Guerrero-Cuellar was raised in Little Village and the Chicago/West Lawn area, graduated from Hubbard High School, and holds a B.A. in international relations from Roosevelt University.
It says Guerrero-Cuellar was previously a community outreach organizer during the COVID-19 pandemic and an auxiliary board member of the National Museum of Mexican Art.
